scope: Current McHenry County Clerk, Treasurer and Sheriff rosters only; no new races imported.

source.title: McHenry County Clerk: Certified Candidate List, General - 11/3/2026
source.accessMethod: Opened official county candidate page in Edge using CUA, observed the current 8/24/2026 link, downloaded that exact link through the browser, extracted local PDF text and visually inspected rendered page 2. No captcha, authentication or security-warning bypass was involved.
source.dateNote: August 24 is the update label observed on the county landing page. The PDF itself prints the general-election date and Certified Candidate List title, but no publication timestamp was found. The metadata does not misrepresent the landing-page update as a printed PDF date.

integration.recommendedVerificationNote: Candidate names, parties and vote-for-one limits verified November 1, 2026 on page 2 of the McHenry County Clerk's current linked certified list for the November 3 general election. The county labels the link updated August 24, 2026. Confirm any later changes and write-in eligibility with the Clerk.
integration.removeResolvedLimitation: Latest county list blocked; using older June candidate list.

limits: The absence of a named write-in from these three list entries is not a separate certification that no later write-in is eligible.
This is an office-roster check, not an address-specific ballot determination.
No other candidates or offices in the four-page PDF were imported or audited in this bounded gap-closing task.
Only public names, parties, offices and vote limits were transcribed; no personal addresses or contact details were included.
